text: Cycles are great for getting around town or exploring new places, but they require some maintenance to keep them running smoothly. One of the most important pieces of equipment for a cyclist is the gear system, which allows you to adjust the speed and power of your bike. You'll want to have a variety of gears to choose from, so you can pedal at different speeds depending on the terrain and how hard you want to work. Additionally, it's important to wear a helmet to protect your head from accidents and injuries.
